title: Compliance Ops Hub: automated questionnaire synthesis and evidence bundling
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Build a 'Compliance Ops Hub' feature that automatically ingests customer questionnaire requests, synthesizes required evidence (DPA clauses, data residency proofs, retention config snapshots), and produces an exportable audit packet. Scope: (1) a questionnaire parser that maps common control questions to Redwood artifacts, (2) an evidence collection pipeline that pulls configuration snapshots and access logs, (3) automated DPA clause lookup and versioning, and (4) a single-click export (PDF/ZIP) with an audit manifest and chain-of-custody notes. Success metrics: reduce manual SOC/compliance team response time from avg 5 business days to <4 hours for standard questionnaires; 90% automated coverage for top-40 vendor/customer questionnaire items; export generation latency <2 minutes for medium-sized accounts. Non-goals: this ticket does not implement a full questionnaire authoring UI, nor does it onboard new custom legal templates beyond templated DPA clauses. The first tranche targets hosted and Dedicated deployments (VPC integration will follow in a subsequent ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Questionnaire ingestion endpoint accepts CSV/XLSX/JSON forms and returns a parsed mapping of questions to control IDs within 2 min
Automated evidence collector returns required artifacts (DPA clause, data residency snapshot, retention policy export, last 30-day audit logs pointer) for 90% of top-40 questions without manual touch
Export package contains an index manifest, signed timestamps, and links to original artifacts; package passes internal audit checklist
A runbook (Confluence link) exists with instructions for manual remediation steps when automated coverage is incomplete
E2E demo recorded and validated with Solutions team on 2 pilot customers (one EU, one US)
notes: Trade-offs discussed: heavy automation requires reliable config snapshotting; to limit blast radius we will pull read-only snapshots and precomputed residency tags rather than live DB dumps
Decision: prioritize mapping library for common questionnaire frameworks (SIG, VSAQ, custom vendor forms) before building full NLP intent matching
Fallback: when an artifact is missing, system should generate a flagged item in the package with suggested owner and automated PR template to create missing evidence
Data residency: evidence collector will include a signed region-of-processing statement and storage bucket residency snapshot (object metadata) for Private deployments where accessible
Retention: include retention policy exports and sample S3 lifecycle configs; for Dedicated/Private we will include configuration pointers and required commands for customer-managed infra

implementation_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): build questionnaire ingestion API + static mapping library for SIG/VSAQ items
Phase 2 (3 weeks): evidence collector implementation calling snapshot endpoints and DPA clause store; build export manifest schema
Phase 3 (2 weeks): package generation, signed timestamps, and UI flow for Solutions team; pilot with two customers
Phase 4 (Ongoing): expand mapping coverage, add NLP-based intent recognition, and integrate Private/VPC snapshot connectors
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sensitive data in exported artifacts — Mitigation: redact PII and provide clear chain-of-custody notes; exports stored temporarily and auto-expire after configured retention
Risk: Private deployments may restrict snapshot access — Mitigation: create a lightweight agent pattern that customers can run to produce the required evidence bundle locally
Risk: Legal disagreement on clause language — Mitigation: include clause version metadata and a pointer to Legal's canonical DPA document; require Legal sign-off for any template changes
